risks.risk: Transmission may be damaged internally (slipping, delayed engagement, worn clutches/solenoids) despite looking intact externally.
risks.proof: Video of a functional test (engage R/D, show no abnormal noises) OR a mechanic’s diagnostic scan/printout showing no stored faults.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to work (worst-case treated as needing repair/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Torque converter condition unknown (stall damage, contamination, leaks) which can cause repeat failures.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the torque converter area and any serial/part number, plus a photo of fluid (if drained) showing color/metal debris.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as converter condition unknown (worst-case treated as potentially faulty/needs replacement).

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete kit (valve body, sensors, harness connectors, cooler lines, bolts) not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out: all loose parts/sensors/solenoids/valve body components included, and a full view of the gearbox with connectors clearly shown.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gearbox only (worst-case missing small parts that increase repair cost).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (cracks, bent housings, broken mounts) not obvious from these photos.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of all edges/corners and mounting points, plus a short video rotating/inspecting the casing for cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically used with potential minor damage risk (worst-case treated as requiring inspection).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox ID/part number label and any stamped numbers on the casing (must be readable).
Video proof of operation (engage gears) or a mechanic diagnostic scan showing no faults.
Photos of the torque converter serial/part number and any fluid condition (color + metal debris).
Confirm what is included: sensors, valve body, harness connectors, bolts, cooler lines/adapters (show them laid out).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Mercedes automatic transmission assembly, but the specific claimed identifiers (M278 1282 / G63) and the 'worked perfectly fine' condition cannot be verified from the images.
